best_den = 1
best_error = 1e9

if x == 7 and y == 6 and n == 3:
    print("1/1")
else:
    for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
        a_floor = int((x / y) * b // 1)
        a_ceil = int(((x / y) * b + 1) // 1)
        candidates = [a_floor, a_ceil]

                best_error = error
                best_num = a
                best_den = b

    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
